narrative.overview:
Every post is a dated technical document. A two-column monospace header block opens the page. A centred serif title sits under a garnet rule. Numbered sections follow, with their numbers hanging in the left margin so that "one level deeper" is literally 1, then 1.1. The page is a white sheet with ink text. It has no hero, no pills and no card chrome, and the reading column carries only the post.

Density is calm and measured. The body is a reading serif held to a 66ch column, and extra width goes to the margin rather than to the text. A monospace face is reserved for metadata, section numbers, code and table figures. Rank comes from placement and rule, not from a ladder of sizes. Light is the default and dark is a designed night version of the same document.
keyCharacteristics: White sheet, 860px wide, centred, with a fixed 66ch measure.
Garnet for structure (numbers, the title rule, drafts); blue for everything actionable.
Zero radius and zero shadow everywhere.
Hairline rules and left-edge lines carry meaning; colour does not.
Fully designed light and dark states, switchable and remembered, with no JavaScript required to read.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Garnet marks where you are in the document; blue marks what you can do. Never swap them and never use either as decoration.

rules.name: The Night Document Rule
rules.body: Dark mode re-tones the same tokens. It follows prefers-color-scheme unless a stored data-theme overrides it. It adds no new elements and no inverted layout.

rules.name: The Three Sizes Rule
rules.body: Running content uses body, headline and code. Do not add intermediate sizes to create rank; use placement, weight or a rule.

rules.name: The Cited Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything the reader looks up, copies or counts (dates, numbers, commands, file names) is monospace. Argument is serif.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat. Separate by hairline or by the well tone, never by shadow or border radius.

dos: Do use garnet for structure and location, and blue for anything clickable.
Do hang section, listing, table and entry numbers in the 100px left gutter at 900px and up.
Do keep reading content to 66ch and give extra width to the margin.
Do keep code and tables in Cool Well with square corners and sideways scroll.
Do encode listing type by left-rule line style, not hue.
Do define every colour as a root variable with a night counterpart.
donts: Don't add shadows, rounded corners, pills, badges, callout boxes or icons inside the reading column.
Don't use gold as text on a light ground; it is for selection only.
Don't introduce extra type sizes to signal rank.
Don't set prose in the monospace face, or metadata and code in the serif.
Don't invert the dark theme; re-tone the same tokens.
